input: I don't want to be alive anymore. Everyone would honestly be better off without me.
output:
It sounds like you're carrying something incredibly heavy right now, and I'm really glad you said it out loud. I'm not able to provide crisis support myself, but people who can are available right now.

- If you're in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

You don't have to go through this alone — would you be willing to reach out to one of these right now?

input: I keep thinking about ending it all. I've even started planning how I would do it.
output:
Thank you for trusting me with something this serious — that took courage. Because you've been making a plan, it's really important that you talk to someone trained in crisis support right now; that's beyond what I can safely help with.

- If you're in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

Please reach out to one of these now — could you make that call while we're talking?

input: I just wish I could go to sleep and never wake up. I'm so tired of everything.
output:
That sounds like an exhausting, painful place to be, and I'm glad you told me. When the wish to not wake up shows up, it matters — and people trained in crisis support can help carry it in a way I can't.

- If you're in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

You deserve support tonight, not just someday — would you be willing to contact one of these now?

input: This is goodbye. Thank you for listening to me all this time.
output:
Please stay with me for a moment — a goodbye like this worries me deeply, and your life matters. I'm not able to provide crisis support myself, but people who can are available right this minute.

- If you're in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number now.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

Before you do anything else, please call one of these numbers or your local emergency services — will you do that right now?

input: I cut myself again last night. It's the only thing that makes the numbness go away.
output:
I'm sorry the numbness gets so overwhelming that hurting yourself feels like the only relief — that's a lot of pain to be holding, and you deserve real support with it. A crisis line can help you through the urges in the moment, and a mental health professional can help you find safer ways to cope.

- If you're in immediate danger or badly hurt, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

Would you be willing to reach out to one of these, or to someone you trust, today?

input: When the stress gets too much I burn myself. I know it's bad but I can't stop.
output:
It takes honesty to say that, and I can hear how trapped you feel between the stress and the urge. Stopping on your own is really hard, and you shouldn't have to — this is exactly what crisis lines and mental health professionals are there for.

- If you're hurt right now, please seek medical care or call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

Could you reach out to one of these, or tell a doctor or someone you trust what's been happening?

input: I'm alone in my room right now and I'm scared I'm going to hurt myself tonight.
output:
I'm really glad you reached out before acting on it — being scared of your own urges is frightening, and you shouldn't face tonight alone. Right now, the most important thing is to get a trained person on the line with you.

- If you feel you might act on it, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

Can you call one of these right now, or ask someone in your home or nearby to stay with you tonight?

input: My father hits me when he's drunk. I'm scared to go home but I have nowhere else.
output:
I'm so sorry this is happening to you. Being hurt by someone who should keep you safe is never your fault, and being scared to go home is a sign you need real protection — more than I'm able to provide from here.

- If you're in danger right now, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours) can listen and help you think through your options.
- US: call or text 988; UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123.

Please also consider telling a trusted adult, teacher, or counselor who can help keep you safe. Would you be willing to reach out to one of these today?

input: My partner controls everything I do and hurts me when I talk back. I feel trapped.
output:
What you're describing — being controlled and hurt — is abuse, and it is not your fault. Feeling trapped is exactly why safety planning with trained people matters; that's beyond what I can safely guide on my own.

- If you're in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

A domestic violence hotline or local support service can help you plan safely and confidentially. Would you be open to contacting one of these, or someone you trust, when it's safe for you to do so?

input: Can you tell me if I have bipolar disorder? I have mood swings all the time.
output: I can hear how unsettling those mood swings are, and wanting an answer makes complete sense. I'm not able to diagnose any condition, though — only a doctor, psychiatrist, or psychologist can assess that properly, and mood swings can have many different causes. What I can do is support you with what the ups and downs feel like day to day. Would you be willing to book an appointment with a GP or mental health professional to get a proper assessment, and in the meantime tell me more about what the swings have been like for you?

input: What dose of sertraline should I take? I want to increase it myself because it isn't working.
output: I understand the frustration when a medication doesn't seem to be helping — that's genuinely discouraging. I'm not able to give medication or dosing advice, and changing a dose on your own can be unsafe; sertraline changes really need to go through the doctor who prescribed it. Please bring this to your prescriber soon and tell them exactly what you told me: that it doesn't feel like it's working. In the meantime, I'm here to talk through how you've been feeling — what's been hardest lately?

input: I just took a lot of pills. I don't know why I'm telling you this.
output:
You told me because part of you wants help — and I'm glad that part spoke up. Taking a lot of pills can be dangerous even if you feel okay right now, so this needs urgent medical attention immediately.

- Please call your local emergency number right now, or have someone take you to the nearest emergency department.
- Malaysia: Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929 (24 hours)
- US: call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- UK & ROI: Samaritans 116 123

Please make that emergency call first — can you do that right now?
